description: This file defines the JsonRuntimeException class, a custom unchecked exception for JSON-related errors in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a builder for creating instances with detailed error information.

classes.name: JsonRuntimeException
classes.description: A custom unchecked exception class for JSON errors, implementing JsonException, with support for error codes, descriptions, and links.

classes.name: JsonRuntimeException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing JsonRuntimeException instances fluently.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for JsonRuntimeException with a specified error code.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the description of the error.

methods.name: getHref
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the URI link to more information about the error.
